notes: Unlisted fund ('The Shares are not currently traded on an established trading market'; CUSIP 30290Y 101; no ticker printed) that self-describes as a closed-end management investment company and intends quarterly repurchase offers, hence fund_type interval_or_tender_offer_fund rather than closed_end_fund (judgement call). Size: the offer is for up to the LESSER of (i) 9,959,316 Shares and (ii) the greater of two DRIP-proceeds-based share counts, so 9,959,316 is a ceiling, not a firm size. The stated 5% is of the weighted-average Shares outstanding for calendar 2020, not of current outstanding (198,983,536 Shares as of February 11, 2021); recorded as 5 with that caveat. Price 'equal to the NAV per Share' recorded as 100% of NAV. NAV is struck as of March 31, 2021, the day after the stated March 30, 2021 expiration; the $7.4179 NAV as of January 31, 2021 is only an illustration. commencement_date is the Offer to Purchase date (Section 5 says April 26, 2021 is 40 business days after commencement). The offer is not conditioned on a minimum tender and has no financing condition. Per-holder tender rules (tender at least 25% or all shares; $5,000 minimum remaining balance) are restrictions on individual tenders and are not counted as offer conditions. Section 3 also lists credit/FX limitations and war or calamity; these are mapped to market_disruption. No results in this filing.
